conditions.compiled_execution: NUMBA_DISABLE_JIT=0; NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1; the case schema has no thread-count setting
conditions.matrix_policy: orthogonal coverage; output=all is limited to one short regular-field row per suite
conditions.process_isolation: each observation uses a fresh process and private initially empty NUMBA_CACHE_DIR

identity.core_definition: final/release/boundary/failure/series payload; output frames, probes, execution partition, timing, RSS, and manifest are excluded

interpretation.artifact_throughput: artifact bytes divided by simulate time is effective end-to-end result throughput, not pure background-writer bandwidth
interpretation.hard_checks: completion, exact frame/probe shape and row counts, pinned revisions, memory-plan fit, field-path compiled-dispatcher evidence, and scientific identity
interpretation.rss: process high-water RSS includes Python/native libraries and is separate from the solver-owned memory plan
interpretation.timing: absolute seconds and scaling ratios are descriptive machine-local evidence

solver_memory_plan.semantics: predicted peak of solver-owned arrays; not process RSS
